notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Things are going well production is in full swing, No ETA yet on release we want to make sure it is perfect.

We have just added a night "freezing" effect so make sure to keep those fires burning!

The world still needs populating as it is a bit lifeless at the minute, Also the story is coming along so far we have around 1/2Hrs of story driven quests.

Here is a new promo video we will try to get a new video up every 1/2 weeks.

Enjoy.

RPG

notes.title: The "BETA" is now LIVE!
notes.content:
The "BETA" is now LIVE!


We have decided to make it an "OPEN BETA" for all Steam owners of 10YA
to be able to participate in the beta you will need to opt-in through steam, To do this please follow these instructions.

right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". 

Among the available tabs will be the "BETAS" tab.

The beta should be listed in the dropdown menu under "Select the beta you would like to opt into:"

You may need to re-start steam to be able to view the tab.
 

 

Please take the time to read the information below, we'd like help with checking that 10YA runs successfully. We'd particularly like to know: 

•if any functions fail to operate 

•if there are any performance issues remaining.  



Notes: 

1. Rock Paper Games may withdraw this beta software at any time and will withdraw it at the end of the testing period. 


The following improvements are contained in this version of Chapter 1: 


Optimisation of particle effects 

Improvements in use of multicore machines 

Casting lights are scaled back on lower settings 

Improved anti-aliasing 

New Player Model 

New Island level (Unfinshed)

New "BASIC" AI 

Crafting 

Multiplayer 

Upgraded graphics 

New animations 

Updated inventory/crafting interface 

Updated day/night cycle 

New female character 

Base building added (BETA TEST) 

New save/load system 

3 different characters to pick from 

Infected "should" only appear at night/dusk

PLEASE NOTE :

The beta has been set up in such away that you can easily gather resources and there should be plenty lying around for you to test out the crafting and building systems.

Chapter 1 "BETA" is just a test of crafting,inventory,building and multiplayer you can play singleplayer as it is just the same but not online. 

There are NO "QUESTS/STORY" or friendly NPC'S in this build.

The map/models and animations are not all complete, this is more noticed on multiplayer where weapons etc will appear out of scale in the 3rd person view.

You will also notice invisible blockers at the edges of the map.

Also we are aware of a bug if you are running "Avast" where the game will fail to load and steam will "hang" please disable "Avast" before running the beta.
 

Please report bugs using the rockpapergamesdev@gmail.com email address.



Many Thanks 

RPG Team

notes.title: Development Roadmap and new Info
notes.content:
[h1]10 Years After Development Road Map [/h1] 


[b] Phase 1: 	[/b] 

  

Go back to basics,  

  

Rework player model to include new : 

  

Animations 

  

Weapons 

  

Hands/Arms 

  

  

  


[b]Phase 2: 	[/b] 

  

Revamp Inventory 

  

Revamp Hunger/Thirst 

  

Revamp Crafting 

  

Add base building 

  

Revamp Save system 



[b]Phase 3: 	[/b] 

  

New AI System 

  

New Map 

  

Update Graphics 



[b]Phase 4:  	[/b] 

  

Revamp Quest system 

  

Revamp Story Mode 

  

  

  


[h1]Update Procedure  [/h1] 



10 Years After will now be updated in Modules, once each module is perfected the development team will move onto the next. 

  

10 Years After will also now launch in "Chapters"  each Chapter will be a free update to owners of the game there will only be one charge for users and that is the initial payment made through Steam. 






[h1]MODULES  [/h1] 



[b]Chapter 1: 	[/b] 

  

After escaping the infection in a plane , You crash land on a small island and need to learn to live from the land and construct shelters until you can be rescued by a passing ship. 

  

  

Dev Notes: 

  

This first chapter gives us chance to test the survival and building systems along with hunger/thirst systems and basic animal AI 


[b]Chapter 2: 	[/b] 

  

Your saved! ....Or are you! the government ship that saved you from your little island holiday has taken you to a survivor camp to be processed. 

  

Dev Notes: 

  

The second chapter introduces the quest and dialogue system to the game, as well as more advanced AI and combat systems 


[h1]Chapter 3/4/5 will be announced soon [/h1] 


Regards

RPG

notes.title: 0.0.9 Releases @7pm UK Time
notes.content:
Update: 0.0.9 has been uploaded to steam and will be live at 7pm uk time

the website is also now back online after a re-vamp to go with the games re-vamp and we have added .................drum roll please ..................

MULTIPLAYER !.........multiplayer will now be available from the start menu in 0.0.9.

it is still in its early stage and you will spawn into one of two groups "survivor" or "raider" 

the aim is to stay alive and take each other out,of course this will be expanded on in the next update, as will the story mode which at the moment you can only get so far with (as we ran out of time) so expect an update to 0.0.9 soon.

Here is the full Change Log:



Change Log : 0.0.9 

Upgraded to unity 5

New main menu

New Loading screen

New world (now 1 big map) 8km square

New player legs system

Updated inventory and crafting system

Added Factions

New time of day system

Added in game achievement system (steam achievements to follow)

New NPC Characters:
1. Tony
2. Jimmy
3. Alfie
4. Liam "Bear" Royal
5 . Richard
6. Jack
7 . Paulette
8 . Josh
9.  Jacob
10. Kyle
11. Jilly


Added Drivable Vehicals:
1. SUV
2. Truck
3. Bus
4 . Van
6 . Sedan

New Wenlock Prior area

New wastlands Area

New PineWood Town area

New Trees and grass

New spawn system

New infected AI system ( no more getting stuck behind objects infected will work out another route)

Lots of new quests

Added Waypoint system to help you find your way 

New pause menu integrated into inventory system

Added some new infected types

Added new crafting materials : pan/cloth/sticks/metal scraps/ductape

New NPC's aware of big events i.e you kill certain main characters others will react in a different way leading to different quests

Added occulsion culling to help with fps

Added new spawn system for infected and crafting items

Added Blockers when/if you reach end of map (this is temporary for now)

New ingame Music

New ingame notification system of areas 

New main menu Music

New loading screen music

New Multiplayer Mode (Alpha) you will spawn in a random group of "Survivors" or "Raiders" this is a timed team match for now in the full 10YA world.

New Death Screen

New Loading Screens





Known Bugs:

When in car/truck/bus etc the waypoint indicator position is wrong but the distance is correct

Removed:

Voice acting .....it will be back but we are re-casting for all roles
all of 0.0.8 as you know it!

Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: UPDATE ON 10YA 0.0.9
notes.content:
As you are aware 10YA has been on hold for a few weeks i can assure you all that it is back under development full time and that during the time that has passed 10YA is under going some major changes to the story and the world ,

the biggest change is the timeline as 10YA was originally set in the present day the new 10YA will be set sometime in the future also the story's main plot being about the injection is still intact but instead of zombies they are now "reaper" like creatures 

also due to 10YA now being set in the future it opens up the possibility of space flight and new worlds (theses are under development as we speak) 
and of course more futuristic weapons , factions will be in place also. 
so to some it up 10YA is now a universe rather than a planet and all the horrors that go with it 

also at the moment we are trying out a 3rd person controller with regards as replacing the 1st person .....it is just testing at the moment and a small video will be uploaded soon of a test we made showing off the new look 10YA 

Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: Update On Alpha 0.0.7
notes.content:
Well as you are aware we are working mostly on the outside areas including the city and the town things are going well a few problems have come about but we are mostly on course for the update coming out this weekend coming!...

What i can confirm is that 10YA is being completely re-worked from the start of the game to the outside area and during some initial tests we are getting a solid 60FPS in the new outside area!

Also as a way to achieve the fps and up the graphics a notch we have separated the towns from the woodlands.

So now you will find and follow a few roads (where you will find infected who have made there way out of the town/city)  until you get asked if you would like to enter the city/town.

You are still free to wander about and come and go as you please between the town/city and the woodlands areas.

During testing this way and dynamic loading it as you walk around we found this way we were able to really up the graphics and keep a nice steady fps rate.

This has also let us drastically increase the size of the city and the town and let us add more grasses and better trees and textures on the woodlands area.

You will also now still start in the flats but you will escape to an outside area where you will have to make your way through the streets and enter the hospital ...the rest we shall keep secret :-)

As i have already said we hope to have this out for 14th/15th of this month as long as things go well,

Depending on the feedback of 0.0.7 we shall then start addressing some of the smaller things for a 0.0.7a patch and then hopefully we can start adding in some cool stuff for 0.0.8


Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: Today's Patch 0.0.6a
notes.content:
[h1] Patch 0.0.6a may break your last save[/h1] 

[b] Bugs Fixed:[/b] 

- Clipping zombies (Dev has confirmed next update hopefully) ///// [b] Adjusted "infected" collider animations and attack/listen distance to help combat this issue working on better AI to completely fix this[/b] 


- Zombies are hard as nails! (dev to test and rethink health of zeds)///// [b] "infected" Health Now Reduced[/b] 


- The camp-fire is lit by Leon but flame is switched off by accident, next build ;)///// [b] "Fires are now Lit"[/b] 


- All of the sheds by Alexis Ridge have no clipping.///// [b] Sheds Now Fixed[/b] 


- Woodside doesn't exist in the game, the marker is from an old build. ///// [b] Woodside is in Build[/b] 


- Thirst/ hunger go down too fast and aren't replenished enough by certain items.///// [b] Hunger/Thirst Adjusted may need more depending on feedback[/b] 


- Crafting costs too many materials.///// [b] Reduced Crafting Cost on some items[/b] 


- Day/ Night cycle is very short.///// [b] Extended day/night Cycle possible more depending on feedback[/b] 


-Removed Confusing Main Menu ///// [b] Replaced with Basic Menu for now PLEASE NOTE: you can not adjust graphics or volume etc you can still use "P" in game to drop or raise graphic settings[/b] 


- Fall damage takes an ok amount of health, but maybe shouldn't kick in for lower heights. ///// [b] Fall Damage slightly adjusted[/b] 


- I would recommend the amount hostile bandits taunt/ threaten you be lowered. (Risks becoming a broken record (Ofc will help when there's more taunts/ threats!)). ///// [b] removed for now[/b] 


- There is an invisible wall between Alexis house and the powerline next to it (By the shed). ///// [b] Removed powerline as believe this was causing this invisible  wall[/b] 


- Added Better [b] "Space to Skip" information[/b] 


- [b] "L" now turns flash-light on/off[/b]  also you now don't lose it and will always have your flash-light 



[h1] Next Patch will address outside Area and Head shots This will Fix These Issues[/h1] 

-Known fps drop when 'leaning' (Q/E or LB/ RB (Xbox controller) - Otherwise controller support In its current partial state works fine and will be updated to include inventory and communicate with npc.

- Distant Terrain/ LOD could do with improving.

- WHEN OUTSIDE FOR NOW, PLEASE LOWER GRAPHICAL SETTINGS ON LOWER RIGS - The game currently loads the whole outdoor terrain map including city at once, of course this is temporary. I have i7-3770k, 16GB RAM & GTX 970 MSI OC and get between 30-60 (Dipping very low at times). THIS CAN LEAD TO A GREEN SCREEN CRASH.

- Separate hitboxes for zombies heads are needed, as currently taking many headhits to kill

- [b] "L" now turns flash-light on/off[/b]  also you now don't lose it and will always have your flash-light

-Known fps drop when 'leaning' (Q/E or LB/ RB (Xbox controller) - Otherwise controller support In its current partial state works fine and will be updated to include inventory and communicate with npc.

- Distant Terrain/ LOD could do with improving.

- WHEN OUTSIDE FOR NOW, PLEASE LOWER GRAPHICAL SETTINGS ON LOWER RIGS - The game currently loads the whole outdoor terrain map including city at once, of course this is temporary. I have i7-3770k, 16GB RAM & GTX 970 MSI OC and get between 30-60 (Dipping very low at times). THIS CAN LEAD TO A GREEN SCREEN CRASH.

- Separate hitboxes for zombies heads are needed, as currently taking many headhits to kill

notes.title: 10YA Features and things to remember
notes.content:
[h1] 10 Years After Things To Expect :[/h1] 

Infected lots and lots of infected

Save/Load system (basic but works) ...When loading game there is no loading screen yet so it will appear like it is not doing anything it is just wait

Huge 5km square main map

3 starting levels to work through until you find your way outside

Guns/Melee weapons

Raiders

Voiced quests and main character 

Basic crafting (this will be expanded in the next update after bug fixes)

Stumble across your own corpse

pick up Apocalyptic Radio Broadcasts as you wander round

Animals

Hunger/Thirst System

Day / Night Cycle

Weather Effects

And lots more but we don't want to give it away ;-)


[h1] Things to take note of:[/h1] 

This is an [u]Early Access Game[/u] so expect bugs in the game be that a floating pig or getting stuck somewhere! this is the main point of early access so you can help us test and find any bugs.

Some models in-game are just place holders and will be update as we move along, also some to almost all of the infected animations are being re-worked so these too are just place holders for now.

New quests are being written as we speak and we hope to have these in-game in the next week or two to help expand the 10YA world.

Stay Safe Afters
